recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片可見多染性大紅血球、有核紅血球（上方深染小核與左下方嗜鹼性母紅血球），左上箭頭所指的大紅血球內有Howell-Jolly小體，右側箭頭為淡灰藍、輪廓不規則的多染性紅血球，符合新生兒溶血時的紅血球生成反應。
features: Large polychromatophilic red cells, including one containing a Howell-Jolly body (thin arrow)
Pale blue-gray, irregularly outlined polychromatophilic red cell (thick arrow)
Nucleated red cells: a small orthochromatic normoblast and an early normoblast with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and fine chromatin (lower left)
Other large immature-appearing mononuclear cells with coarse chromatin, likely erythroid precursors or lymphocytes
Macrocytic red cell background with anisocytosis; no spherocytes clearly evident at this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisocytosis with numerous large polychromatophilic red cells, one containing a Howell-Jolly body (thin arrow), and a pale, irregular polychromatophilic cell (thick arrow). Nucleated red cells are present, including an orthochromatic normoblast and an early normoblast with deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Spherocytes are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with a brisk erythropoietic response with circulating erythroid precursors, as seen in hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn.

ddx.vs: Healthy newborns have macrocytosis and a few nucleated red cells, but not the degree of normoblastemia and polychromasia seen in hemolytic disease, which is confirmed by a positive DAT.
Hyposplenism shows Howell-Jolly bodies with target cells and acanthocytes but without marked polychromasia or early normoblasts.

ddx.dx: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia or megaloblastic anemia
ddx.vs: These show dysplastic or megaloblastic erythroid precursors with inappropriately low reticulocyte response rather than brisk polychromasia.
